dependencies.reason: Potential parent; actual two parent-race IDs and RP-priced trait catalogs selected by player. No automatic inheritance until source races are verified.

issues.reason: Parent races and RP-priced trait catalogs are unresolved; seven mandatory selection categories cannot be offered as verified selectable options. Banned parent race combinations (Antica, Galka, Genome, Gnath, Immortal, Mandragora, PuPu, Seto Lion, Shindroid) must be enforced. The source has an additional no-RP-limit note; seek GM approval.

Ancestral Arms consumes EITHER one of two parent-derived slots, never both. Requires exact selected target at choice time. Half-Breed source also grants eligibility for both parent racial favored class options and archetypes, unresolved until parent canonical IDs exist.
Favored rewards must be reconciled with chosen parent racial favorites and classes, and normal Multitalented eligibility; class spell and companion catalogs missing.
Rule effects are mechanically paraphrased staging interpretations, not independently approved. No changes to live wizard or production manifest are authorized by structural validation.

Source rechecked: the current FFd20 race archive has no verified per-trait RP metadata for filtering inherited selections. Full parent identity/movement/language and selection validation are required. The server now blocks Half-Breed creation even if all standard traits are disabled.

features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: During creation, choose one ability to gain a +2 racial bonus.

features.name: Size
features.description: Choose the size of one selected parent race; inherit that size and all size-derived modifiers.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid bearing both parent racial subtypes; counts as both for racial effects.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: Calculate the mean of parent land speeds. Where applicable, derive climb, flight and burrow values from the parents as described by source. Do not assume automatic access to unchosen movement modes.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begin with Common and one language from either selected parent. High-INT choices may be any language permitted by the Linguistics rules.

features.name: Defense Trait Selection
features.description: Select one parent race defensive racial trait priced at no more than 3 RP, if available.

features.name: Feat and Skill Trait Selection
features.description: Select one parent feat/skill racial trait of at most 3 RP, if available.

features.name: Magical Trait Selection
features.description: Select one parent magical racial trait costing at most 3 RP, if available.

features.name: Movement Trait Selection
features.description: Select one parent movement trait costing at most 3 RP, if available.

features.name: Offense Trait Selection
features.description: Select one parent offense trait costing at most 3 RP, if available.

features.name: Senses Trait Selection
features.description: Select one parent senses trait costing at most 3 RP, if available.

features.name: Weakness Trait Selection
features.description: Select one parent weakness racial trait, if available; no numeric RP limit specified.

features.name: Blood
features.description: Treat character as belonging to both chosen parents for race-dependent rules.

features.name: Multitalented
features.description: Select two favored classes when first gaining character level 1. Receive normal favored rewards for levels gained in either one; not double benefits for a single level.

features.name: Strength choice bonus
features.description: Selecting this option applies +2 racial bonus to Strength once. Other options are not granted.

features.name: Dexterity choice bonus
features.description: Selecting this option applies +2 racial bonus to Dexterity once. Other options are not granted.

features.name: Constitution choice bonus
features.description: Selecting this option applies +2 racial bonus to Constitution once. Other options are not granted.

features.name: Intelligence choice bonus
features.description: Selecting this option applies +2 racial bonus to Intelligence once. Other options are not granted.

features.name: Wisdom choice bonus
features.description: Selecting this option applies +2 racial bonus to Wisdom once. Other options are not granted.

features.name: Charisma choice bonus
features.description: Selecting this option applies +2 racial bonus to Charisma once. Other options are not granted.

features.name: Ancestral Arms
features.description: Select Exotic Weapon Proficiency or Martial Weapon Proficiency for one weapon, gained at first character level. Replaces either selected feat/skill or offense slot.

features.name: Dual Minded
features.description: Gain +2 bonus on all Will saves, replacing defense slot.

features.name: Eye for Opportunity
features.description: Gain +1 racial on attack rolls for attacks of opportunity, replacing defense slot.

features.name: Mismatched
features.description: Take -2 on Reflex saves and gain +4 racial on initiative checks. Replaces feat/skill slot.

features.name: Scavenger
features.description: Gain +2 racial to Appraise and specified Perception checks for hidden items, spoiled food, or potion tasting. This replaces the two-favored-classes ability.

features.name: Sociable
features.description: After missing a Diplomacy attitude-influence DC by 5 or more, retry before normal 24-hour restriction. Replaces feat/skill slot.

features.name: Stubborn
features.description: +2 racial Will versus enfeebling spells and spell-like effects. After initial failure, make a second save next round at same DC if effect lasts beyond one round. Other similar second-save abilities cannot activate in same round. Replaces Multitalented.

condition.description: Against enfeebling school spells and SLAs only

features.name: Wary
features.description: Gain +1 racial on Bluff and Sense Motive, replacing feat/skill slot.

features.name: Water Child
features.description: Gain +4 racial on Swim, take 10 even under swimming stress, and may select Aquan as bonus language. Replaces feat/skill slot and Multitalented.
